title: Lang Co in a day
summary: The beach in the morning, a look at Lap An from the bank, and Hai Van Gate by the pass road if you still want the view back. The tunnel does not count as the gate. Times on the sand are check on arrival.

stops.name: Lang Co Beach
stops.note: Check on arrival. No visit length was published. Swim and walk while the ridge is in the light.

approach.note: The beach is the base if you sleep on the strip. Minutes from the station were not printed.

stops.name: Lap An Lagoon
stops.note: A look from the bank. One description puts that look at about an hour. The sand strip shows only at a strong low tide. A boat price is not a town fee.

approach.note: Nguyễn Văn is the lagoon road. Minutes from the beach were not printed. Check on arrival.

stops.name: Hai Van Gate
stops.note: Check on arrival for time on the summit. The fee is 70,000 VND from 2 June 2026. VnExpress prints 07:00–17:30. Go up the pass road, not through the tunnel.

approach.note: Up the pass road from Lang Co. The tunnel does not pass the gate. Drive minutes are check on arrival.

seoTitle: Lang Co in a day — beach, lagoon, and the gate
seoDescription: A Lang Co day: the beach under Hai Van, a look at Lap An, and the gate by the pass road. The tunnel skips the gate. Times on site are check on arrival.
